localizedDescriptions.zh-Hans: 亚洲写真图集，收录日本写真杂志、韩国和泰国写真、华人写真与角色扮演。

localizedDescriptions.en: An Asian photobook archive with Japanese gravure magazines, Korean and Thai photo sets, Chinese photography and cosplay.
